$comment: Exceptions to @effect/language-service error/warning diagnostics (WS-0026). Checked by scripts/ts/effect-diagnostics.ts: every finding must match an entry by file + rule, and every entry must still match exactly `count` findings (a stale or wrong-count entry fails the check). Suggestion-severity diagnostics are not gated.

exceptions.reason: Two chained Effect.provide calls (services(env) then platform) in the lazy-ingestion gate and the scheduled handler. Merging them into one provide changes layer build/lifecycle semantics and the recovery boundary documented at the call site (catchDefect wraps the provided effect), so it is a behavior change and out of scope for R1.
exceptions.retirement: Owner decides whether to merge the layers; retire with the first WorkScope that touches the Worker composition root (TB-05 event loop replaces the lazy gate) and has runtime-test authority.

exceptions.reason: Test helper provides the service layer then the fake database layer in two calls. Merging changes layer construction in the tests; not a behavior-free edit.
exceptions.retirement: Retire when the test layers are composed into a single test layer in a WorkScope that owns the accounts tests.
